newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Royale Belge ceo sees higher 1997 current profit.
newsitem.headline: Royale Belge ceo sees higher 1997 current profit.

text.p: Royale Belge SA chief executive officer Jean-Pierre Gerard said on Wednesday the group's performance in the fist five months of the year left it confident about achieving a rise in current earnings over the full year.

"Life insurance premiums are up 10 percent. The situation in the non-life sector is more difficult...the rise in premium income was much lower than in life, however, claims remain limited, therefore we can hope for a rise in current results similar to that of previous years."
Current profit in 1996 was 7.1 billion Belgian francs, up from 6.6 billion in 1995 and 6.0 billion in 1994.
